summary: Keep the existing Bleutec Industries production record deferred without a database or seed mutation. The fresh direct ATRS board packet resolves the exact historical fund as EnCap Energy Transition Fund II and reports a December 2022 commitment date, $68.7 million commitment and $5.5 million invested capital. Direct sources still do not establish the legal relationship and current status of the three Bleutec entity names, EnCap's cutoff ownership, vehicle, stake or control, continuing management co-investment, the Title XI application's disposition, a delivered vessel fleet or current operations.
resolvedFormerBlockers: The direct September 25, 2023 Arkansas Teacher Retirement System board packet identifies EnCap Energy Transition Fund II, L.P. and lists Bleutec Industries among Fund II's five committed portfolio companies.
The same direct public-fiduciary packet reports Bleutec's commitment date as December 2022, Fund II commitment as $68.7 million and invested capital as $5.5 million as of the September 2023 report.

The packet describes Bleutec's business as developing and operating offshore wind turbine and pile installation vessels, but also says all five Fund II portfolio companies were still in early startup and primarily funded overhead; this is historical business-plan evidence, not proof of delivered vessels or cutoff operations.

The direct EnCap release confirms a 2022-11-30 equity commitment, management investing alongside, Houston and a 2019 founding, while the direct 2023 Bleutec deck confirms full capitalization with EnCap and planned circa-2026 deployment.
The direct NETSCo page establishes an ABS design Approval in Principle rather than construction or delivery, and the direct MARAD approvals page does not supply a final Bleutec Title XI disposition.
